H. Rider Haggard, Maiwa’s Revenge.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/h-rider-haggard/maiwas-revenge

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- H. Rider Haggard, the author, died 1925.

First publication of the text used: 1888 (SE colophon: 'Maiwa’s Revenge was published in 1888 by H. Rider Haggard'; Wikipedia, 'Maiwa's Revenge': publication date 1888, publication place United Kingdom).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1888, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die did so in 1925, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 1996.
